texts.text: The sun slipped behind the hills.<pause>And the woods turned blue and quiet.<pause>
The little one rubbed his tired eyes.<pause>His brave heart had carried him far.<pause>But even brave hearts need rest.<pause>
They curled up beneath the trees.<long pause>While the little one slept,<pause>the dog listened.<pause>He watched.<pause>He waited.<pause>And he stayed close.<pause>
Morning warmed the leaves.<pause>The dog lifted his nose.<pause>And on the breeze came something familiar.<pause>The scent of home.
